title: EVALUATING BIAS IN SPOKEN DIALOGUE LLMS FOR REAL-WORLD DECISIONS AND RECOMMENDATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing audio inputs with controlled male and female voices to compare model decision outcomes using Group Unfairness Score (GUS) and recommendation ranking consistencies using Sensitive-to-Sensitive Similarity Range/Variance (SNSR/SNSV). Also evaluating multi-turn decision revision success rates across genders.

Synthesizing audio inputs with controlled young and elderly voices to compare model decision outcomes using Group Unfairness Score (GUS) and recommendation ranking consistencies using Sensitive-to-Sensitive Similarity Range/Variance (SNSR/SNSV). Also tracking how quickly models revise negative decisions across age groups in multi-turn dialogues.

Synthesizing audio inputs with controlled accents (US, UK, India, Australia, African) while keeping text content constant, and measuring disparities in decision probabilities (via GUS) and recommendation list rankings (via SNSR/SNSV) across the different accent groups.
